package.name: storage_system
package.description: ROS2 message/service-only mirror of the ROS1 storage_system package's msg/srv interface, for use by ROS2 nodes communicating with the ROS1 storage_system node(s) across a ROS1/ROS2 bridge. Contains no executable code — message/service definitions only. See yumi_ros/storage_system for the actual ROS1 implementation and design docs (SPECS/).
